module_summary: Virtual-FIFO read side: issues AXI read bursts from DRAM between read and write pointers, buffers returned data in per-segment dual-clock FIFOs with gray-coded pointer sync, and streams segments out.

anchors.name: rd_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: DRAM read-issue pointer; sets burst address and length versus write finish pointer.

anchors.name: rd_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: DRAM read-completion pointer, advanced per accepted read beat.

anchors.name: wr_finish_ptr_in
anchors.why: Write-side finish pointer; data available in DRAM determines burst length and issue.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid, raised when a full burst or timeout burst is issued.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: AXI read address ready; clears arvalid.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Burst address: base plus masked read start pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Burst length from computed rd_burst_len.

anchors.name: rd_burst_len
anchors.why: Burst length: up to burst boundary or remaining available data.

anchors.name: rd_timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Countdown before issuing a partial burst when data is pending.

anchors.name: rd_timeout_reg
anchors.why: Partial-burst timeout expired; allows short burst issue.

anchors.name: rd_outstanding_reg
anchors.why: Outstanding read beats: incremented by burst issue, decremented per read beat.

anchors.name: sts_read_active
anchors.why: Read active status when outstanding beats nonzero.

anchors.name: cfg_enable
anchors.why: Enables issuing new read bursts.

anchors.name: cfg_fifo_base_addr
anchors.why: DRAM FIFO base address added to masked read pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data written into per-segment FIFO memories.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid; with rready writes FIFO and advances finish pointer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Read data ready when local FIFO not full or under cfg reset.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_mem_data
anchors.why: Per-segment dual-clock FIFO RAM buffering AXI read data.

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Local FIFO write pointer addressing segment memories on each read beat.

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_gray_reg
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer for crossing into output clock domain and full check.

anchors.name: read_fifo_wr_ptr_gray_sync_2_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer synchronized to output clock; used for segment empty.

anchors.name: read_fifo_rd_ptr_sync_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer synchronized back to clk, binary-decoded for occupancy.

anchors.name: read_fifo_full
anchors.why: Local FIFO full; blocks rready and FIFO writes.

anchors.name: read_fifo_occupancy_lookahead_reg
anchors.why: Occupancy including issued bursts; gates new burst issue for FIFO space.

anchors.name: read_fifo_read_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Reserved FIFO pointer advanced by burst length when a burst is issued.

anchors.name: read_fifo_read_start_en
anchors.why: Burst-issue enable reserving FIFO space.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Per-segment read pointer in output clock domain addressing segment memory.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_empty
anchors.why: Segment FIFO empty; blocks segment read.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_data_reg
anchors.why: Segment output data register read from FIFO memory.

anchors.name: read_fifo_seg[*].seg_rd_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: Segment output valid register driving output_valid.

anchors.name: output_data
anchors.why: Segmented output data from per-segment read registers.

anchors.name: output_valid
anchors.why: Per-segment output valid.

anchors.name: output_ready
anchors.why: Per-segment downstream ready; allows next FIFO read.

anchors.name: rst_sync_3_reg
anchors.why: cfg_reset synchronized into output clock; resets output-side pointers.

groups.name: AXI read burst generator
groups.description: Computes burst address/length from DRAM pointers, timeout for partial bursts, issues AR.

groups.name: Outstanding read counter
groups.description: Tracks issued but not yet returned read beats.

groups.name: Read data FIFO write side
groups.description: Writes AXI read data into segment FIFO memories; full and space-reservation logic.

groups.name: Pointer CDC synchronizers
groups.description: Gray-code pointer synchronizers between clk and output_clk domains.

groups.name: Segment output read
groups.description: Per-segment reads in output clock domain driving output data/valid.

groups.name: Output reset synchronizer
groups.description: Synchronizes cfg_reset into output clock domain as output_rst_out.
